qualification: Empty mappings, case presence, C-only or partial runs never close options. Every row needs actual C-calibrated observations and same-candidate paired evidence.
existing_interface_review_corrections: hostname_issubdomain(a,b) tests whether b is equal to or below a: local existence is exact/ancestor, not arbitrary descendant.
IPv6 explicit single/range condition leaves prefixlen0; compare image C before choosing match policy.
UDP PTR does not itself enumerate; matched interface forward query, actual newaddress conditions, file check_servers and parent TCP accept are distinct publication callers.
mapping_note: Explicit row maps select candidate profiles only. No row is qualified by map presence, C-only calibration, or earlier partial paired runs.

calibration_corrections.observation: Exact musl image atoll numeric overflow wraps low 64 bits, rather than the pre-calibration saturation hypothesis. 2^64 => 0, 2^63 => 0x8000000000000000, 2^64-1 => u64::MAX.

qualification_scope_policy: Ordinary complete interface/dynamic/synthetic contracts close independently. Extreme-input differences retain their frozen rows and raw red evidence for later repair under the user policy.

known_deferred_components.reason: Frozen overflow input 4294967296 is retained as extreme-input C/R difference; C wraps to zero, Rust rejects. Ordinary empty/text/negative and valid-width contract still qualifies.
Overlong appended SRV owner maximum-name input remains unexecuted extreme component; ordinary one-dot owner/suffix ordering is qualified separately.
